assertions.assertion: Static delivery does not imply absence of browser saved configuration or external service requests.
Disclosure describes request constructors/callers, not new transmissions or provider retention/handling. Connection IP is external-request context, not a newly measured leak.
GeoJS then ipinfo fallback have no typed-query/coordinate URL parameters; local Intl timezone and approximate area do not establish GPS or permission.
Trimmed length<2 returns without requests; Nominatim q/format/addressdetails/limit and digit+homeCC countrycodes; builder1000ms/Enter and widget Enter callers.
Whitespace removed, leading letter-digit-letter triggers only uppercase first3 FSA plus Nominatim, including malformed longer strings. No full postcode/coordinates appended.
700ms coordinate edits, ownership and numeric guards, both auto-controls off return; BigDataCloud lat/lon/localityLanguage=en; widget geolocation does not call builder reverse.
Eligible request pathdate and latitude/longitude/method/school; caches and adopted currentness are boundaries, not newly qualified behavior.
Eligible simulation/currentness/caches guards and exact lat/lon/zone/unit/day/field constructor. No direct local observation claim.
Coordinate-free manifest; returned latest-past host/frame with location-derived tile indices; uncalibrated alpha is not precipitation amounts/observation.
Google stylesheet family/style/weight and gstatic declaration omit widget query/coordinates; declarations are cache/network conditional, not every-load transmission proof.
Exact current-field sequence matches current URL constructor.
One-shot optional user gesture; reported accuracy or unknown, decimal precision is not accuracy; local allow is conditional on actual parent policy and grant.
Acquisition time/accuracy preserved apart from savedAt; future/nonpositive malformed evidence remains unknown, zero future allowance; portable target omits private fix history, not presence.
Save failure still binds session target; retained persistence warning and measured write outcome, writable partition/lifetime conditional, no blanket partition failure.
Only config KEY removed; failure publishes result before return and leaves prior target; success may coarse re-detect. Caches/providers are not erased.
Access/delegation/policy/grant/storage/lifetime conditions retained; no qualified TablissNG version or actual-parent claim.
Credited prayer/weather/radar constructors carry configured location/context; settings and caches use browser storage if available. Old blanket no-storage claim removed.

regions.text: var KEY = "salah_widget:config:v1";   // versioned persistence key (NOT shared with prayer/weather caches)

Self-configuring embeds & privacy: location is approximate and uses GeoJS, with ipinfo.io as fallback. Place/postcode searches go to Nominatim and, for matching Canadian-style prefixes, Zippopotam. Builder reverse lookups send coordinates to BigDataCloud; the widget also requests prayer, weather, radar and font resources. Saved settings stay in your browser, which does not prevent these service requests. Precise location is optional and requires browser/host permission. An iframe host, including TablissNG, can strip allow="geolocation"; coarse/manual setup remain available. Storage policies can limit persistence. Request details.
